phases.title: Freeze The Admission Boundary And Split Support From Legality
acceptance: support posture and admission posture land as distinct retained runtime artifacts rather than one vague readiness/status model
admission report aggregation is explicit and typed, including denied, unsupported, wrong-world, deferred, admitted, and admitted-with-advisory outcomes
unsupported and deferred lanes fail through support posture before ordinary legality dispatch rather than pretending to be local validator failures
world-aware support and admission posture remain visible and machine-checkable on the ordinary path
phases.instructions: Freeze the admission boundary first. Make support truth and touch-local legality truth separate before touch classification or family selection broadens the surface.
phases.qa_focus: No validation blob, no support/admission collapse, no boolean stop states, and no implicit aggregation semantics.

phases.title: Define A Typed Graph Touch Descriptor With Origin, World, And Aspect Precision
acceptance: UiGraphTouchDescriptor is sealed, typed, and precise about target class, origin, world, timing, aspect posture, and affected runtime lanes
ordinary touch authority rejects generic 'node changed' or rerender-shaped touches as the main selection boundary
touch descriptors originate only from admitted upstream receipts rather than caller-local guesswork
equivalent touch descriptors converge while coarse or contradictory touch construction denies before selection
phases.instructions: Make touch the one canonical selected-work input. Keep it precise enough that the runtime can select obligations without broadening into graph-global validator folklore.
phases.qa_focus: No catch-all touch bags, no ambient world inference, no raw caller-forged touches, and no node-changed ordinary path.

phases.title: Make World-Aware Support And Admission Typed Runtime Artifacts
phases.owner: worth-ui support and admission posture authority
acceptance: support rows and admission posture are world-aware and distinguish supported, unsupported, deferred, diagnostic-only, wrong-world, wrong-query-basis, wrong-host-capability, stale, ambiguous, rebind-required, and budget-exceeded posture
the same family can be supported in one world and denied by wrong-world posture in another without changing family identity
support and admission artifacts are fully interpretable without string parsing or host memory
typed posture remains visible to later diagnostics and inspection as retained evidence instead of presentation-only text
phases.instructions: Turn posture into runtime authority. Make world sensitivity, support visibility, and admission denial classes structurally explicit before family selection lands.
phases.qa_focus: No hidden world gates, no string-only unsupported posture, no diagnostic-only work masquerading as support, and no support drift into verdict text.

phases.title: Admit Obligation Families Through A Closed Selection Matrix
acceptance: the initial obligation family catalog is closed and typed, with no catch-all validation family
each selected obligation has stable identity, explicit check kind, and typed selection reasons
the milestone ships a first closed selection matrix for representative structural, measurement, query-binding, and diagnostic touch classes
selection derives from typed touch meaning plus graph/index authority and support posture instead of caller-remembered validator packs
phases.instructions: Close the family taxonomy and make selection mechanically visible. Family identity, check kind, and selection reason all need to be explicit before dispatch exists.
phases.qa_focus: No generic validation bucket, no family/check-kind collapse, no vague selection prose without a starter matrix, and no caller-local validator tables.

phases.title: Lower Selected Obligations Into Dispatch Plans And Typed Verdicts
phases.owner: worth-ui obligation dispatch and verdict authority
acceptance: selected obligations lower through UiObligationDispatchPlan into typed verdicts with explicit class or stop posture rather than pass/fail or text-only results
unsupported, deferred, diagnostic-only, wrong-world, wrong-query-basis, wrong-host-capability, stale, ambiguous, and budget-exceeded posture remain structurally distinct from advisory/violation
dispatch executes only obligation-checking work admitted for 3.4 and does not prematurely execute measurement, Query, intent, or service runtime families
same touch, graph generation, support snapshot, and prerequisite evidence produce the same selected obligations, dispatch shape, and verdict classes
phases.instructions: Keep dispatch narrow and honest. This phase is about turning selected obligations into typed legality evidence, not sneaking later runtime execution into 3.4.
phases.qa_focus: No pass/fail collapse, no execution-family creep, no rediscovered selection at dispatch time, and no unstable verdict identity.

phases.title: Consume Query, Host, Measurement, And Service Prerequisites Without Rebuilding Their Runtimes
acceptance: Query-backed requirement families consume Query-owned basis, projection-consumption, inspection, and causal explanation lanes rather than UI-local substitutes
host-capability requirement families consume typed host posture without giving adapters legality or support ownership
measurement and service requirement families remain prerequisite/requirement checks only and do not execute later runtime slices
portal, focus, and motion requirement families carry explicit unsupported, diagnostic-only, or architecturally-owned-but-not-yet-admitted posture until their service milestones land
phases.instructions: Integrate the prerequisite boundaries without leaking ownership. Worth UI can require Query or host facts here, but it cannot restate or execute their runtimes.
phases.qa_focus: No Query-local basis labels, no materialization-row spelunking, no host-owned legality, and no half-service implementation hiding in requirement checks.

phases.title: Emit Evidence, Diagnostics, And Inspection Hooks For Obligation Work
acceptance: selected obligations, selection reasons, verdicts, and admission reports retain typed evidence handles instead of logs or broad report blobs
later inspection can answer why an obligation was selected or not selected from retained selection-reason evidence
diagnostic projections remain derivable from the same evidence that AI and human inspection surfaces consume
evidence indexing is strong enough to target graph node, touch, obligation family, denial posture, and prerequisite source without broad dumps
phases.instructions: Make 3.4 explainable on day one. Selection and legality evidence are part of the runtime family itself, not a late diagnostics afterthought.
phases.qa_focus: No log-first evidence, no selection archaeology, no diagnostic-only truth, and no missing reason traces for why work ran or did not run.

phases.title: Mechanize Boundary Enforcement And Close A Proof-Bearing Handoff To Later Runtime Slices
acceptance: compile-fail, residue, and topology proof block caller-forged touches, caller-selected validator packs, renderer-local legality helpers, and public bypass of obligation authority
the closeout enumerates the exact touch, support, family, selection, dispatch, verdict, Query-boundary, host-boundary, evidence, budget, and aggregation lanes 3.4 closes
later runtime slices consume sealed touch/admission/verdict authority instead of raw graph/declaration internals or ad hoc helper state
equivalent touch descriptors under the same graph generation, support snapshot, and prerequisite evidence converge to equivalent admission reports
phases.instructions: Close the milestone with proof and an exact handoff. Make the anti-folklore boundary mechanical so later measurement, Query, intent, service, and rebind work inherit one honest obligation system.
phases.qa_focus: No public bypass, no stale helper residue, no broad-scan ordinary path, and no fuzzy handoff to later runtime slices.
